evidence_limits: Original material comes from the pinned repository. New files only extract or capture existing content and record verification; no experiments or checker execution were performed.
Examples and README excerpts are actual repository text; expected verdicts are authored examples rather than fresh audit outputs.
The PASS transcript is embedded saved checker output in example05. Its occurrence was verified in source; Lean and Mathlib were not installed or executed here.
The informal benchmark scores in summary.json were produced with tools disabled; they do not measure Lean verification.
The benchmark README explicitly describes 21 easy saturated cases, model-dependent results and over-strict false rejections; it does not establish general superiority.
An interactive example can reveal recorded steps and counterexamples. It must not claim to audit arbitrary submitted proofs or animate a new checker execution.
Other copied examples have expected verdicts only; do not attach the example05 saved PASS to them.
